text:
Maya: Quick alert — Northbridge renewal is ready for signature but procurement sent back a new Tax ID and wants a delegated approver listed. They said current envelope can't be completed until we update the billing info.

Tim: Copy. Which Tax ID did they provide? That can change invoicing entity and might impact our revenue recognition.

Maya: Sent in DM earlier but pasting here: `Tax ID: 98-7654321` and procurement wants approver: `Elena Kurian (Purchasing)` with email elena.k@northbridge.co.

Olivia: FYI legal needs to confirm the SOW entity matches the Tax ID. If it's a different legal entity we need an amendment signed. Can you confirm the entity name on the SOW?

Maya: SOW shows "Northbridge Technologies, Inc." — procurement says billing should be "Northbridge Holdings LLC".

Raj: This means a billing-entity amendment, not just a metadata update. Two options: (1) re-issue amendment and new envelope to the new entity + approver, or (2) have current entity sign and procurement submit an internal invoice-transfer. Procurement preferred (1).

Tim: If we go with (1) finance needs a fresh PO referencing the amended entity. Ask them for PO with the new legal name and tax id. Otherwise we can't bill.

Maya: I asked procurement for PO. They replied with a provisional PO number but said they will only issue final PO after we publish the amendment. Provisional: `PO-XX-3421`

Sara: Ops note — if amendment is required, onboarding credit applied in Q3 for service disruption will need to be re-authorized. Do we want to offer a small onboarding credit to speed signing? :thinking_face:

Raj: Offering credit could help. Sales is ok with up to one month credit to get this over the line. Confirm with finance.

Tim: Finance approves up to 1 month credit only if revenue deferral is documented. I'll need a short note from CSM + sales.

Maya: I'll draft the note. Quick question — can we reuse the existing DocuSign envelope and just swap signers/entity?

docusign-bot: Envelope 0a9f3b sent at 2026-03-20T16:02:12Z. Status: completed (2/3 signers).

Olivia: We should not reuse completed envelope. Create a new amendment document referencing the original contract ID and include the new legal entity details + signature block for Elena.

Maya: Got it. Drafting amendment now. I'll attach the amendment and run it by legal. ETA 2 hours.

Raj: I'll prepare an internal sales note to authorize the 1-month credit and attach it to the amendment package.

Tim: Once amendment PDF is ready, send to finance with PO request: require final `PO-` number, billing email, and remittance address. I'll fast-track payment terms approval if PO and tax ID match.

Maya: Thanks — looping @olivia and @tim once draft is uploaded. Will ping when DocuSign envelope is created for Elena. :thumbsup:

docusign-bot: New envelope created: `env-20260321-77` — awaiting signature (Elena Kurian).
_meta: Generated Slack thread for renewal execution: billing entity / tax ID change, delegated approver, PO and onboarding credit coordination.
